name: Being Sad
overview: Scripture teaches that true hope and comfort in times of sadness come from faith in Jesus Christ, who is the way to the Father and the source of eternal life. Believers are encouraged not to let their hearts be troubled but to trust in God’s power, for with Him all things are possible. While not all who call Jesus 'Lord' will enter the kingdom, those who do the will of the Father can find assurance. Ultimately, readiness for Christ’s return and reliance on His promises provide peace amid sorrow.
